steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Configure package name, meta-data, and dependencies for Patient Entry Manager.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target SDK 34 and Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare permissions, activities, launcher theme, and application entry points.

steps.title: Add App Meta Asset
steps.description: Create runtime app-meta.json inside assets folder for app_id resolution.

steps.title: Implement Generic Backend API Client
steps.description: Build BackendApi.java for auth, OTP password reset, and generic CRUD endpoints.

steps.title: Implement Image Worker Client
steps.description: Build ImageWorkerApi.java for secure cloud image uploading, fetching, and deletion.

steps.title: Create Patient Data Model and List Adapter
steps.description: Implement Patient model and custom ListView adapter with search support.

steps.title: Implement Authentication UI
steps.description: Create screens and layouts for user registration, login, and forgot password OTP reset.

steps.title: Implement Main Dashboard Screen
steps.description: Build patient list display with live filter search, refresh, and detail navigation.

steps.title: Implement Add/Edit Patient Screen
steps.description: Create form for adding/editing patient info, capturing or selecting image, and compression upload.

steps.title: Implement Patient Detail View Screen
steps.description: Build full record viewer with secure private photo rendering, edit, and deletion options.

steps.title: Building Patient Entry Manager
steps.description: Final compilation and validation of native Android code and API schemas.
